purpose: Exact baseline for rolling back the Cedwyn host-routing modification performed on 2026-10-28. Restore this single rule to revert to ruleset version 26 behavior; delete the story CNAME only if the new alias is also being removed.

baseline_rule.expression: http.host in {"records.bucklerfamily.estate" "docs.bucklerfamily.estate" "wayback.bucklerfamily.estate" "nomenclature.bucklerfamily.estate" "maps.bucklerfamily.estate" "infographic.bucklerfamily.estate" "wiki.bucklerfamily.estate" "fb.bucklerfamily.estate" "chess.bucklerfamily.estate" "csscpsg.bucklerfamily.estate" "fcg.bucklerfamily.estate" "oldbill.bucklerfamily.estate" "accounts.bucklerfamily.estate" "authorities.bucklerfamily.estate" "review.bucklerfamily.estate" "qa.bucklerfamily.estate" "app.bucklerfamily.estate" "chat.bucklerfamily.estate" "watchtower.bucklerfamily.estate" "fb2.bucklerfamily.estate" "dartboard.bucklerfamily.estate" "directory.bucklerfamily.estate" "terrain.bucklerfamily.estate" "shop.bucklerfamily.estate" "research.bucklerfamily.estate"} and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.path.extension in {"" "html" "htm"} and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api") and not http.user_agent contains "cedwyn-archive" and not http.user_agent contains "Chrome/124.0 Safari" and not (http.host eq "fcg.bucklerfamily.estate" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/first-seen") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/standard") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/case") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/mandate"))) and not (http.host eq "research.bucklerfamily.estate" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/1962-possession-order") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/1974-licence-letters")))

rollback_steps: PATCH the same ruleset/rule ID with baseline_rule.action, action_parameters, enabled and expression.
Confirm the phase entrypoint is back to 10 rules and rule set reflects the original host set.
DELETE the story DNS record by added_dns_record.id only if the new story hostname should be withdrawn.
Repeat the HTTP route suite after rollback.
